name: (01) Thaumaturgy (Path of the Focused Mind) — 1 Basic — Readiness

system.description:
The disciplined mind of the Kabbalist jump-starts its own sluggish synapses, sharpening thought to a keener and quicker edge.

Readiness may be used only upon yourself. While it is active you are three Traits up on all Mental Challenges relating to leaps of logic, investigation, memory or reasoning. The power lasts from one scene up to an hour. (The Path of the Focused Mind may only be practiced by thaumaturges with at least seven Mental Traits.) Retest with Occult.
